# ENDOCARDITIS WITH GRAM NEGATIVE BACILLI OTHER THAN HACEK ORGANISMS

Pseudomonas aeruginosa and various Enterobacteriaceae are uncommon endocarditis
pathogens. Risk factors include cirrhosis, IV drug use and prosthetic valve.

Choice of agents should be based on in vitro susceptibilities.

Begin treatment with a beta-lactam agent, and when appropriate, Infectious
Diseases will initiate treatment with add-on aminoglycoside or fluroquinolone
agent for additional coverage.

Consult Infectious Diseases and Cardiothoracic surgery in all cases.

## Treatment for Enterobacteriaceae

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) M for 6 weeks](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)

## Treatment for Pseudomonas

Most cases of pseudomonas endocarditis occur in IV drug users.

[Cefepime  2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R for 6 weeks](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)
